title: Birth in Mobile, brothers and mother's music
summary: Born 10 July 1911 in Mobile, third of four boys; mother played organ and piano and made them all study music; Cootie started on drums at five or six.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Cootie, let's start right at the beginning, and supposing you tell me what year you were born.
Well, I was born July the 10th, 1911, in Mobile, Alabama.
And will you tell me about your family? About your mother and father and how many children there were in the family and so on.

There was four boys and we all had to take music. My mother played the organ in church, and the piano, and so we all had to take music. And I was the only one that followed her footsteps, I would say. The rest of them went into other fields.
Well, which son were you? Were you number one, two, or what?
I was number three.
You were number three. How many years difference were there between you and your brothers?
Well, the oldest one was seven years older than me. The other one was three years older than me.
I see. Was it your father or your mother who insisted on you studying music? It was your mother, wasn't
Yeah.
And what -- did they all -- did everybody study piano then?
Yeah. A little bit. I was a drummer.
You were a drummer.
I loved the drums.
So you had a feeling for the drums right away, did you?
Uh-huh.
And did your father buy you some drums then?
Yes.
Well, how old were you then?
I think maybe around about five.
Oh, that's wonderful.
About five or six years old.
Well, let's go back a minute. Other than your mother, was there music in your family farther back? Your grandmother or grandfather?
I don't remember them.
You don't.
No music, no. Only my mother.
Only your mother. And she was an organist as well.
